name: Hebron
overview: Hebron was a male member of the tribe of Judah, identified specifically as the son of Mareshah. Little additional information is provided about his life or role beyond this genealogical note.
namesAndTitles: The name Hebron means 'association' and is a proper name mentioned in Scripture. It was not given by God but is recorded in 1 Chronicles 2:42.
familyAndRelationships: Hebron is recorded as the son of Mareshah and the father of Korah, establishing a direct lineage within the tribe of Judah as noted in 1 Chronicles 2:42-43. No other family relationships are documented in Scripture for Hebron.
scriptureSignificance: Hebron's significance lies primarily in his place within the genealogical records of Judah, serving as a link between Mareshah and Korah. This genealogy contributes to the broader biblical narrative of the tribe of Judah, from which the Messiah would ultimately come. His mention underscores the importance of faithful lineage in God's providential plan.
